title: Review Summary Widget
content: Build review summary widget. Overall rating: large star display with average (4.5/5), total review count. Distribution: horizontal bar chart showing 5-star to 1-star percentages. Key highlights: AI-generated pros/cons summary from reviews. Category ratings: if applicable, sub-ratings (Quality, Value, Comfort). CTA: "Write a Review" button. Filter links: click rating bar to filter reviews by that rating.

variants.simple: Create review summary showing rating distribution and highlights.
variants.detailed: Build review summary widget. Overall rating: large star display with average (4.5/5), total review count. Distribution: horizontal bar chart showing 5-star to 1-star percentages. Key highlights: AI-generated pros/cons summary from reviews. Category ratings: if applicable, sub-ratings (Quality, Value, Comfort). CTA: "Write a Review" button. Filter links: click rating bar to filter reviews by that rating.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive review summary widget aggregating product feedback. Container: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6, or full-width section on PDP. Layout: responsive grid with overall rating left, distribution right, or stacked on mobile. Overall rating display: extra large star rating visualization (5 filled/unfilled stars, large scale), numeric average prominently displayed (text-4xl font-bold "4.7"), total review count below ("Based on 2,847 reviews"), verified purchase badge if all verified. Rating distribution: vertical list of 5 rows (5★ to 1★). Each row: star count label ("5 ★"), progress bar (h-2 rounded-full), percentage or count. Bar fill: proportional to count, color gradient (5★ green, 1★ red) or brand color. Click interaction: clicking a bar filters reviews to that rating, highlight selected. Animated bars: bars animate to fill on initial load. Category/attribute ratings: grid of sub-ratings if applicable. Categories vary by product type: Apparel (Fit, Quality, Comfort, Style), Electronics (Performance, Value, Ease of Use, Build Quality), each shows average (4.2/5) with mini stars or numeric. Review highlights: AI-generated summary section. "What customers are saying" header, pros list (green checkmarks): top 3-5 positive themes extracted ("Great battery life", "Easy to set up"), cons list (red X or minus): top concerns ("Runs small", "Slow shipping"). Quote snippets: 2-3 short customer quotes with attribution ("Best purchase ever" - Sarah M.). Keyword pills: clickable tags for common themes mentioned (clicking filters reviews containing that term). Recommendation percentage: "92% of customers recommend this product" with visual bar. Verified purchase indicator: "X% verified purchases" trust signal. Review call-to-action: "Write a Review" or "Share Your Experience" button, prompts for purchase verification or opens review form modal. Photo/video summary: thumbnail grid of user-submitted media from reviews, "See all X photos" link opening gallery. Sort/filter controls: sort dropdown (Most Recent, Highest Rated, Lowest Rated, Most Helpful), filter by rating, verified only, with photos. Compare to similar: "See how this compares" link to category average comparison. Syndicated reviews: note if reviews aggregated from multiple sources. Mobile: stack sections vertically, collapsible detailed sections. Accessibility: progress bars have proper aria-label with percentage, interactive elements focusable, summary readable linearly.
